messages:
suresh: Quick sync for Lithos instrumentation roster and run cadence. Goal: joint perf/W + sustained throughput sweep for marketplace certification.
cheng: Proposed knobs: FAST_KERNEL=1, KV_OPT_LEVEL=2, and quant variants q4f16 / q2_k. We'll run 4 repeats per config and collect seeds 10..14.
katie: For the marketplace assets we need two stable artifacts: 
 - efficiency-profile (optimized for joules/token)
 - throughput-profile (optimized for sustained tokens/s)
Acceptance thresholds suggestion:
 - efficiency-profile: >= 5.0 tokens/J at seq=256, p95 latency <= 120ms
 - throughput-profile: >= 1.8M tokens/s sustained over 120s with <=8% variance
suresh: add thermal headroom target: at steady-state, case temp delta < 12C vs ambient and throttle events = 0.
paul_hw: We'll attach Lithos telemetry agent (v0.9.8) to the nodes. Telemetry will be gzipped jsonl to s3://lithos-bench/redwood/raw/. Sample record (one line): 
{"ts": 1746003210, "node": "lithos-a1", "power_w": 792.5, "tokens": 1450000, "seq": 256, "config": "q4f16|FAST_KERNEL=1|KV_OPT_LEVEL=2", "mode": "throughput", "run_id": "run-2026-03-30-01"}
cheng: please include top-level fields mode, seed, run_id, and kernel_sha. I will write a jq pipeline to aggregate tokens/s and watts per second.
katie: CI integration: bench job partners/lithos-sweep will kick off matrix and upload summarized csvs + plots to the doc. bench bot?
lithos-bot: CI job queued: partners/lithos-sweep (id: 2026-03-30-09). Estimated full sweep time: 28h. Artifacts will post to s3://lithos-bench/redwood/artifacts/. :robot_face:
suresh: timeline: prep/smoke Tue evening, full sweep Wed-Thu, draft results Fri morning. Who takes the first draft for the marketplace listing? @katie?
katie: I can do the first draft. Need the following from Lithos: exact kernel commits, hardware SKU list, and a CSV of raw telemetry.
paul_hw: I'll provide kernel SHAs and a brief changelog. Also note: we expect to apply two micro-patches to scheduler; we'll record patches and revert instructions.
cheng: one more test: run a long-tail latency test (random 10s bursts) and record p99.9. If p99.9 > 500ms, flag for follow-up.
suresh: add rollback / customer protection: if post-listing metrics show >5% regressive perf on Dedicated customers pinned to the marketplace artifact, we pause rollout and open incident. Add to runbook.
katie: noted. I'll add sections to the doc: test matrix, telemetry schema, CI job ids, artifact links, and rollout playbook. Will ping when draft is ready. :memo:
suresh: thanks all. locking dates Wed/Thu. Meeting tomorrow 9:30 PT to finalize matrix. :calendar:
